title: Typhoon Cempaka to briefly enter PAR; Amihan surge to affect Luzon
summary: The tropical cyclone with international name Cempaka intensified into a typhoon Sunday afternoon ahead of its entry into the Philippine area of responsibility, according to PAGASA.
